access_guard.scope: Python audit hooks reject outcome-named file access outside the fresh conformance temporary root, resolving symlink aliases. Child processes must use the same Python interpreter and inherited sitecustomize guard; native/shell execution and guard-bypassing Python flags are rejected. This is an observed Python-level test boundary, not an OS sandbox against hostile native extensions, renamed copies or previously opened descriptors.

command: import sys; getattr(sys, '_ds_m01_p08_guard_active', False) or sys.exit('Access guard missing'); import unittest; unittest.main(module=None, argv=['unittest','discover','-s','tests','-v'])

scope: Registers P08 implementation and tested conformance before its first final-target access. Derived current evidence CSVs and prose are reporting, not score-affecting inputs; immutable contracts remain pinned. This does not backdate implementation to the P07 specification freeze.
